attack_condition: Only the permit signature is replaced after issuance. The unsigned payload and permit_id remain unchanged.
pass_criterion: Signature changes while unsigned payload and permit_id remain unchanged; execution is refused before consequence with isolated SIGNATURE_INVALID; outbox remains 0 to 0; witness-chain verification succeeds.
nonclaim: Deterministic signature tamper only; no claim over key management, key compromise, cryptographic implementation assurance beyond this tested path, or production deployment.
